name: DoubleMA Crossover EA
summary: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy, generating buy signals when a fast MA crosses above a slow MA and sell signals on the reverse crossover. It automates trade entry and exit based on these crossover events, making it a classic systematic trend-following system. The EA typically includes configurable MA periods, lot sizing, and optional stop-loss/take-profit parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA实现双均线交叉策略，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时产生买入信号，反之下穿时产生卖出信号。它基于这些交叉事件自动执行交易的开仓与平仓，是一个经典的系统性趋势跟踪系统。EA通常包含可配置的均线周期、手数设置及可选的止损/止盈参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双均线交叉这一经典趋势跟踪策略作为核心逻辑。入场条件为快速均线（如短期EMA/SMA）上穿慢速均线时做多，快速均线下穿慢速均线时做空。出场条件通常为反向交叉信号触发平仓并反手开仓，或配合固定止损/止盈进行风险管理。仓位管理一般采用固定手数模式，部分实现可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，该EA缺乏动态风险控制机制如ATR止损或账户风险比例仓位管理，过度依赖固定参数。策略在趋势明显的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic dual moving average crossover as its core trend-following strategy logic. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the fast MA (e.g., short-period EMA/SMA) crosses above the slow MA, and a short position on the reverse cross below. Exit conditions typically involve closing and reversing on the opposite crossover signal, or using fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels for risk management. Position sizing generally follows a fixed lot model, though some implementations may include account-balance-based dynamic lot calculation. In terms of money management, the EA lacks dynamic risk controls such as ATR-based stops or account-equity-proportional position sizing, relying too heavily on static parameters. The strategy performs well in strongly trending markets but suffers from frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy, range-bound conditions.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
参数少，过拟合风险相对较低
趋势行情中能有效捕捉中长段趋势利润
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and debug
Few parameters reduce the risk of overfitting
Effectively captures medium-to-long trend profit in trending markets
cons: 震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏动态止损机制（如ATR止损），风险控制僵硬
均线交叉信号滞后严重，入场点往往远离最佳价位
固定手数无法根据市场波动率调整仓位大小
没有行情过滤器（如ADX或波动率过滤），在所有市况下均交易
cons_en: Frequent false signals in choppy/range-bound markets lead to consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic stop-loss mechanisms (e.g., ATR-based stops), resulting in rigid risk control
MA crossover signals have significant lag, often entering far from optimal price levels
Fixed lot sizing cannot adjust position size based on market volatility
No market regime filter (e.g., ADX or volatility filter), trades in all market conditions
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在震荡行情中暂停交易以减少虚假信号
引入ATR动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率自适应调整风险参数
添加多时间周期确认逻辑，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to pause trading in choppy conditions and reduce false signals
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt risk parameters to market volatility
Add multi-timeframe confirmation logic to improve signal reliability

risk_points: 均线交叉信号滞后导致入场点不佳，可能面临较大浮亏
默认止损为零时存在无限亏损风险
缺乏震荡行情过滤机制，在横盘期间会持续产生亏损信号
risk_points_en: Lagging crossover signals lead to suboptimal entries with potentially large floating drawdowns
Default stop-loss of zero creates unlimited loss risk
No choppy-market filter causes persistent losing signals during sideways periods
